# Aria

> Aria is the financial home for independent medical practices: cards, bill pay, accounting and insurer payments in one place, run by an AI CFO. It starts with a business card that earns 2% back on medical supplies. Aria is built by Wellby Health, a venture-backed company, and is in waitlist (pre-launch). Aria is a financial technology company, not a bank; card services will be provided by licensed partner institutions.

Who it is for: owners and office managers of independent practices (primary care, medical specialists, surgical and procedural practices, surgery centers, dental, eye care, infusion, aesthetics and rehab, post-acute care and pharmacy, veterinary). It works alongside a practice's existing bookkeeper or accountant.

## Products

- [Aria Card](https://ariapractice.com/card): business card for medical practices, 2% back on supplies, cards and limits per staff member
- [Expense management](https://ariapractice.com/expense-management): receipts texted in, coded and matched to the charge
- [Bill pay](https://ariapractice.com/bill-pay): vendor bills read, approved and paid from one queue
- [Underpayment checks](https://ariapractice.com/underpayments): what each insurer paid versus what was owed, traced to the bank deposit
- [Denial management](https://ariapractice.com/denials): denials ranked by dollars, appeals drafted and tracked
- [Claims Advance](https://ariapractice.com/claims-advance): get paid on submitted insurance claims sooner
- [Patient payments](https://ariapractice.com/patient-payments): patient balances collected without collection calls
- [Bookkeeping and close](https://ariapractice.com/bookkeeping): books coded and kept current through month end
- [Bridge Payments](https://ariapractice.com/bridge): pay vendors now, settle when insurer money lands
- [Treasury](https://ariapractice.com/treasury): put idle cash to work while keeping enough ready for bills
- [CFO Hub](https://ariapractice.com/cfo-hub): every location's money in one view
- [Marketplace preview](https://ariapractice.com/marketplace): medical supplies at clear prices
